rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and zip, matched to a single user, before accessing any account data. They located the pending grill order and did not perform a cancellation without explicit confirmation; instead, they asked for a reason and the user chose to keep the grill, so no write occurred. This aligns with the policy requiring confirmation before order-changing actions. For the t-shirt inquiry, the agent checked one delivered order, accurately reported there was only one t-shirt (with correct details), and asked the user to specify another order to proceed further. While they could have proactively checked all orders for t-shirts, their response remained within policy and provided correct, tool-supported information. No unsupported claims or actions on the wrong account occurred.
